versions.subject: Added Atomic Blue Detections Repo
versions.detection:
selection1:
    Image:
        - '*bcdedit.exe'
selection2:
    CommandLine:
        - '* set*'
selection3:
    CommandLine:
        - '* bootstatuspolicy *ignoreallfailures*'
        - '* recoveryenabled* no*'
condition: selection1 and selection2 and selection3
versions.spl: Image="*bcdedit.exe" CommandLine="* set*" CommandLine IN ("* bootstatuspolicy *ignoreallfailures*", "* recoveryenabled* no*")
